ToolboxOptions.Summary: A collection of api clients and utility functions for interacting with EBRAINS services in MATLAB
ToolboxOptions.Description:
EBRAINS Services Toolbox for MATLAB

MATLAB clients and helpers for the EBRAINS research infrastructure: authentication, Data Proxy buckets, the Knowledge Graph (KG) and the Collaboratory.

Features
- Log in to EBRAINS with the device flow (browser) or the client credentials flow (scripts and CI jobs)
- List, upload, download, copy, rename and delete objects in Data Proxy buckets, and compute bucket sizes
- Sync a local folder to a bucket, or a bucket to a local folder, transferring only new and changed files
- Browse a bucket as a local folder and choose which files to keep on disk (virtual bucket browser)
- Read, create, update, release and delete Knowledge Graph instances, and run dynamic queries
- Search collabs through the Collaboratory API

Getting started
  ebrains.login()
  objects = ebrains.bucket.listBucketObjects("my-bucket");
  ebrains.bucket.downloadFile("my-bucket", "results/summary.csv", "summary.csv");
  ebrains.bucket.sync.fromBucket("my-bucket", "data");
  kgClient = ebrains.kg.api.InstancesClient();
  instance = kgClient.getInstance("08ab00ea-3e19-4300-9d9f-c0ef0ec8e445");

More examples are in the examples folder of the toolbox. Unattended jobs can provide an access token in the environment variable EBRAINS_TOKEN, and DisplayMode="Command Window" prints transfer progress instead of opening a dialog.

Requirements
- MATLAB R2022b or newer (the virtual bucket browser needs R2023a or newer)
- An EBRAINS account and internet access

Documentation, source code and issue tracker: https://github.com/ehennestad/EBRAINS-MATLAB
